body: The matchmaker had never run under systemd, only nohup'd -- the actual root cause of S170-63's outage. New units (redgarden-matchmaker-bots/players, redgarden-bot-pool) matching fatbaby-newssite/gfd-mud pattern, deployed and verified live including watching Restart=on-failure actually recover the matchmaker after a port conflict. Commit d5deb0b. BACKLOG S170-65.
title: Real systemd units for arena matchmakers + bot pool
